name: Port of Naples (Stazione Marittima di Napoli)
overview_text: Naples is one of the Mediterranean's most prominent marquee ports, located at Molo Angioino directly adjacent to Castel Nuovo and Piazza Municipio.
getting_around: Municipio Metro Station (Line 1) is located directly across the street from the terminal exit. High-speed hydrofoils to Capri, Ischia, and Sorrento depart from adjacent Molo Beverello.
all_aboard_warning: Traffic in metropolitan Naples can be heavy. If traveling back from Pompeii, Sorrento, or Capri, allow at least 60-90 minutes of buffer before all-aboard time.

terminals.name: Stazione Marittima di Napoli (Molo Angioino)
terminals.description: Monumental passenger terminal housing security checkpoints, check-in desks, tourist information, and the Galleria del Mare shopping mall.
terminals.source: Port Authority of the Central Tyrrhenian Sea

terminals.name: Molo Beverello Hydrofoil Pier
terminals.description: Fast ferry and hydrofoil terminal with direct departures to Capri, Ischia, and Sorrento.
terminals.source: Port Authority of the Central Tyrrhenian Sea

terminals.name: Calata Porta di Massa
terminals.description: Vehicle and passenger ferry terminal connecting Naples to the Gulf islands and Sicily.
terminals.source: Port Authority of the Central Tyrrhenian Sea

berths.name: Molo Angioino Cruise Berths (7 Active Berths)
berths.notes: Features 1,100 meters of total quay length capable of handling multiple large modern cruise ships concurrently.
berths.source: Port Authority of the Central Tyrrhenian Sea Berth Directory

arrival_procedures: Direct alongside docking. Upon exit, passengers traverse the modern, air-conditioned Galleria del Mare mall before passing through security gates into Piazza Municipio.
departure_procedures: Direct walk-on embarkation. Baggage drop is situated at the ground floor of Molo Angioino. Lines are well-managed but can experience high congestion on multi-ship call days.

walking_feasibility.description: One of Europe's most walkable ports. Piazza Municipio and Castel Nuovo are 2-3 minutes across the street. Centro Storico and Piazza del Plebiscito are an easy 10-minute flat walk.

provenance.verification_authority: Port Authority of the Central Tyrrhenian Sea & Comune di Napoli 2026
